sources.note: Nothing in prose. The 320-item S.L.L.E. wordlists for Ganjule (Ganjawle) and Gats'ame (Kachama) carry a per-word stress mark (IPA primary-stress sign, rendered 'ø' in the text layer, e.g. Ganjule øgan:de 'axe', ødati 'back' but baøte (Gats'ame) 'back', poøko 'bark'), with no transcription note and no generalisation about stress position.
